sources.label: Morphe android app patches (for apps that I use) - stable releases
sources.author: bearinmind
patch_list: How early each alert is announced.
Unlocks every mood, beta ones too.
Bar with progress and your average speed in an average speed zone. Off until switched on.
Bigger alert pins on the map.
Bigger speedometer and speed limit digits.
Chime when a Flock camera is ahead, from OpenStreetMap. No map pins or routing. Off until switched on.
True black dark mode for AMOLED screens.
Removes sponsored pins, stop ads and ad tracking.
Bigger map labels, a wider arrow and a warm day background.
Android Auto heads-up distances and the traffic bar threshold.
Opens Waze with location off and uses it once it is on. Still needs the location permission.
Removes contacts, calendar, phone, camera and advertising ID access.
Stops Waze's own reminder to register your account.
No crash reports, usage stats or performance data. Traffic reporting stays.
Lets you correct speed limits from the speedometer (unverified).
Shows Waze alerts in Ungoogled Maps on this phone. Waze must be signed in and open.
Chime when a speed camera is ahead, from OpenStreetMap, in any country. No map pins or routing. Off until switched on.
Speed camera sound at any speed
Plays the camera sound even when you are not speeding.
Camera and police alerts in every country. Camera warnings are illegal in some.
One speed limit sign style in every country.
Keeps Waze running without a route so its alerts keep reaching Maps. Uses more battery.

sources.label: Morphe patches for Waze
sources.author: Forsigh Waze
patch_list: How early alerts sound, plus a speed-bump switch and per-alert distances.
Runs above 60 Hz, up to your screen's limit.
Makes the dark UI pure black.
Keeps your auto-zoom choice from being reset.
Shows every camera and road hazard, with switches for the extra kinds.
Zooms the map on the car screen.
Adds arrival time and time left to the car trip bar.
Reaper artwork, the stock ghost in any colour, or your own image (square PNG/JPG/WebP, 432x432 recommended, 192x192 minimum).
Stops the Play Store updating Waze.
Turns police and enforcement alerts on.
Compass always shown and toll price on routes.
Keeps the places you navigated to out of every recent list. Waze still stores them.
Shows the map and alerts on the car's cluster screen.
Stops Waze closing when you leave it.
Shows lane guidance, including straight-ahead hints.
Colour behind the Waze logo while the app starts. #00000000 makes it transparent.
Morphe YouTube Music as a Waze audio partner
Lets Morphe YouTube Music play through Waze.
Stops Waze sending Android Auto screen-switch timings to its analytics.
Floats Waze in a 9:16 window every time you leave it. Known issues: touch does not work on the floating window, and the UI does not scale down.
Stock name by default. Type your own to replace what the launcher shows. The package stays com.waze.
Starts as a guest, straight to the map.
Smooths map movement on Android Auto.
Sign always shown, limit-drop warnings, reporting and sign style.
Size of the speedometer and limit sign, and keeps them on screen.
Picks the map theme for day and night.
Shows the traffic meter on the car screen.
Unlocks all moods on the device.

sources.label: Morphe patch to use Waze with Gearslip
sources.author: waze-gearslip-patch
patch_list: Lets Gearslip, the Android Auto alternative, show Waze on the car screen. Waze's car library accepts only Android Auto itself on a phone; this adds Gearslip (and any other host you list) to the hosts it accepts. Android Auto keeps working…

Stops Waze from showing 0 km/h for a moment while driving on phones without Google Play services. A location without a speed gets one from the distance travelled, or keeps the last speed briefly, and short gaps between locations can be bri…

sources.label: A collection of Morphe patches for Android apps
sources.author: dowjames
patch_list: Increases the Android Auto heads-up (police/enforcement) alert distance to 1200m.

sources.label: Morphe patches for Waze: Patched YouTube Music support, customizable patch setti
sources.author: Waze YT Music
patch_list: Waze shows speed camera alerts on screen, but plays the alert sound only when you drive above the speed limit. This patch plays the sound for every speed camera. Can be turned off in the Morphe patch settings.
Adds a button below the audio and sound buttons of the map. It opens the voice assistant of the device on top of Waze, so the map stays visible.
Adds "Morphe Patch Einstellungen" at the bottom of the Waze settings. It shows all applied Morphe patches with a switch to turn each of them on or off.

Adds a repackaged YouTube Music app (for example patched with Morphe) to the audio partners of Waze, so it can be selected and controlled from the Waze music player. The original YouTube Music app keeps working.

sources.label: Enables Androids default TTS engine
sources.author: Waze System TTS
patch_list: Use Android system TTS for navigation
Adds a system TTS control to Settings and replaces online navigation chunks using Android's default engine.
